question.problem: For two random variables $X$ and $Y,$ we have $\text{Var}[X]=0.24,$ $\text{Var}[Y]=0.06,$ and $\text{Cov}[X,Y]=0.08.$ Find $\text{Var}[2X-8Y].$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that if $X$ and $Y$ are random variables, and $a$ and $b$ are constants, then

$$
\text{Var}[aX+bY]={a}^{2}\text{Var}[X]+{b}^{2}\text{Var}[Y]+2ab\,\text{Cov}[X,Y].
$$

Substituting the given data into the formula above, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[2X-8Y] & ={2}^{2}\cdot 0.24+(-8)^{2}\cdot 0.06+2\cdot 2\cdot (-8)\cdot 0.08 \\  & =0.96+3.84-2.56 \\  & =2.24.\end{aligned}
$$
